scope: Five registered bouncing bolts, route/fallback costs and damage, input energy boundaries, fan geometry, penetration/local immunity defaults, two direct collision callbacks and terminal third collision, progression rejection, shared cooldown and death cancellation. Partial-spawn rollback uses mocked engine boundaries.
limitations: Collision callbacks are invoked directly, without full terrain flight. No complete player/world frames, live network peers, graphical mouse/gamepad acceptance, late join or combat/energy balance. Existing projectile behavior and assets are reused.
